summary_1line: Krishna urges Bhishma to teach dharma; empowered by Krishna’s grace, Bhishma invites Yudhishthira to question him about duties and morality.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna stands beside the arrow‑pierced Bhishma on his bed of arrows as gathered kings watch in silence.
Bhishma, glowing with renewed clarity, speaks from the bed of arrows while Yudhishthira and the princes stand respectfully before him.
Narada and assembled sages gesture toward the dying Bhishma, urging the hesitant princes to question him before sunset.
